hero.title: IT People First
hero.subtitle: Talent Retention Program
hero.description: Transforming talent management through an integrated program that values, recognizes, and retains the professionals who make a difference.

objetivos.title: Objectives
objetivos.subtitle: What we aim to achieve
items: Increase the feeling of belonging
Promote physical, mental and social well-being
Create a culture of continuous recognition and development
Reinforce organizational purpose aligned with social responsibility

solidaria.title: IT People Solidária
solidaria.subtitle: Social Responsibility
items: 1-2 per year – a day dedicated to solidarity
Collection of food, clothes, hygiene products, toys and others
Outdoor activities for employees and families
Solidarity raffle with baskets, vouchers or others upon solidarity participation

bonus.title: IT People Bonus
bonus.subtitle: Financial Recognition
bonus.description: Annual Loyalty Bonus based on years of service on gross salary.
items: Year 1: 1-2%
Year 2: 2-3%
Year 3: Up to x% (Subject to Possibility)

beneficios.title: IT People Retention Benefits
beneficios.subtitle: Valuing Time and Dedication
items: Promote talent retention in the company with extra vacation based on years of permanence
1 extra vacation day for every 2 years of permanence in the company
Promote well-being and quality of life/work

escolha.title: IT People Choice
escolha.subtitle: Flexibility and Autonomy
items: Survey 1 to 2 times a year to understand what benefits to add, remove or modify
Ensure employees are heard and are part of the community
Progress according to the needs of the employees

conclusao.title: Conclusion
items: With this, we managed to expose the company and solidarity through CSR
We managed to promote and reward the company's permanence through the "IT People Bonus" program and "IT People Permanence Benefits"
We managed to listen to our employees and make necessary decisions based on "IT People Choice"
